content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(list-partial(@x, @delta), Real), $#0 > 0$(delta)), list-partial(Analysis.nbh(x, delta), Analysis.nbhDel(x, delta)), Logic.and(Eq(Analysis.nbh(x, delta), Set.sep-typed(@y, Real, $#0 - #1 < #2 \land #2 < #0 + #1$(x, delta, y))), Eq(Analysis.nbhDel(x, delta), Set.sep-typed(@y, Real, $#0 - #1 < #2 \land #2 < #0 + #1 \land #2 \ne #0$(x, delta, y)))))

values.en:
For `x₀ : ℝ` and `delta > 0`, the neighbourhood is `U(x₀, delta) = { x | x₀ − delta < x < x₀ + delta }`; the punctured neighbourhood removes the centre, `U°(x₀, delta) = { x | x₀ − delta < x < x₀ + delta ∧ x ≠ x₀ }`. Equivalently `x ∈ U(x₀, delta) ↔ |x − x₀| < delta`, and `U°(x₀, delta) ⊆ U(x₀, delta)`.

Every epsilon-N and epsilon-delta statement below is phrased as membership in a neighbourhood. That formulation survives the move to metric and topological spaces, whereas the inequality `|a − L| < epsilon` is bookkeeping specific to ℝ.
values.zh-CN:
对 `x₀ : ℝ` 和 `delta > 0`，邻域为 `U(x₀, delta) = { x | x₀ − delta < x < x₀ + delta }`；去心邻域移除中心点，即 `U°(x₀, delta) = { x | x₀ − delta < x < x₀ + delta ∧ x ≠ x₀ }`。等价地，`x ∈ U(x₀, delta) ↔ |x − x₀| < delta`，且 `U°(x₀, delta) ⊆ U(x₀, delta)`。

下文每个 epsilon-N 和 epsilon-delta 陈述都表述为属于某个邻域。此表述能够自然推广到度量空间和拓扑空间，而不等式 `|a − L| < epsilon` 只是 ℝ 所特有的记账方式。
